name: zum Glockengießer
kurzbeschreibung: Cafe Glockengießer at Bachgasse 14, Innsbruck: coffee, cakes, drinks, and snacks with a charming outdoor area.
beschreibung:
The Cafe Glockengießer is located at Bachgasse 14 in the Hötting district of Innsbruck. The café invites guests to enjoy coffee, cakes, and a small culinary treat. Traditional Austrian cuisine, a wide selection of drinks including hot beverages, beer, wine, and cocktails, as well as light snacks, are all part of the offering. On warm summer evenings, the charming outdoor area provides a pleasant place to relax.

The café is wheelchair accessible, dogs are welcome, free Wi-Fi is available, and food can be ordered to take away. Opening hours are Monday to Saturday from 16:00 to 00:00, closed on Sundays. Reservations can be made by phone.
